Build the 2026-10-30 X-Mech Suite snapshot and run the fleet pipeline.

Purpose: Pin CLAW and all 14 Mechs at their current GitHub main revisions,
         create sparse shared clones under $SNAP/mechs, verify clean revisions,
         and run the derived fleet pipeline stages with side-effect checks.
Inputs:  Shared Mech checkouts in /Users/marcin/Documents/VIMSS/ontology/Mechs
         and GitHub API commit heads for CultureBotAI repositories.
Outputs: $SNAP/revisions.json, $SNAP/claw, $SNAP/mechs/*, and updated
         _fleet/data/* + assets/fleet/* artifacts.
Branch:  update/xmech-refresh-20261030
Date:    2026-10-30
helpers.review: Builds/fetches snapshots and runs six derived stages; prepare also refreshes the manifest. Its canary function verifies clean pins and record availability but does not execute a full scan stage. Do not rerun as part of this inventory.

helpers.docstring:
Inspect pinned checkouts and live sites for 2026-10-30 X-Mech secondary stats.

Purpose: Compute exact card counts (at_pin and live), secondary corpus figures,
         audit_notes.json facts, and permalink validity across all 14 Mechs at
         their 2026-10-30 snapshot revisions.
Inputs:  $SNAP/revisions.json, $SNAP/mechs/*, and live Mech GitHub Pages sites.
Outputs: Structured stdout report used to update _fleet/mechs_template.md,
         _fleet/fleet_fragment.html, _fleet/audit_notes.json, and site pages.
